description: Generate stat curves over levels and (optionally) write them into a class. Each curve goes from `start` at minLevel to `end` at maxLevel with a shape: linear, ease-in (slow start), ease-out (fast start), ease-in-out, exponential (constant growth factor) or logistic (S-curve). Without classId this is a pure preview of the numbers. With classId the class's params table is rewritten for minLevel..maxLevel (other levels are untouched) - dry run by default, pass dryRun=false to apply. Follow up with balance_report to see how the new curve plays against enemies.

classId.description: Write the curves into this class

exponent.description: Power for ease shapes (default 2), steepness for logistic (default 8)

param.description: mhp, mmp, atk, def, mat, mdf, agi, luk (or 0-7)

start.description: Value at the first point of the curve

name: generate_param_curve
title: Generate class parameter curve
